description: Add a new cryptocurrency to the supported manual-crypto list by submitting its CoinGecko coin-page URL. Only needed when get_supported_cryptocurrencies does not already list the symbol you want to track.

coingecko_url.description: CoinGecko coin-page URL in the form https://www.coingecko.com/{locale}/coins/{id}, e.g. https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/cardano.

name: add_supported_cryptocurrency
